facility.name: St Paul Christian Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 703 N ELM ST, DENTON, TX, 76201

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: The school age playground did not have the required 9 inches of surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: One child does not have the updated special care needs section in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three children's files had the parents listed as the emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: On the school age playground there are a few wooden planks that are broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The employee listed that was posted was not updated and current.  This was corrected during the inspection with the current list being posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers: The required telephone numbers were not posted.   This was corrected at inspection when the telephone numbers were posted on the parent board.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §746.401(8))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were missing the following items;  -(18) Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity :   (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play  (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation,  (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place,  -(20) the parent rights, &   -(30) Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The operation does not have a menu that demonstrates compliance with USDA meal patterns.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The director did not have their personal training records made available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: 5 staff did not have the required 24 hours of training as they were missing remaining topic hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: 4 staff did not have the required 6 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Cleaning supplies were observed to be within reach of children in two classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 5 staff were missing annual trainings over required content.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: 5 staff did not have annual training in the prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed using a laptop for personal use while supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 2 children were missing medication that is required as a part of their food allergy plans. This was corrected at inspection when parents provided medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: 2 staff were missing the training in the following content area: (1) Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma. (2) Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS).  (3)Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined during a DFPS investigation that a child was left unsupervised on the playground for approximately 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined during a DFPS investigation that the operation did not follow their transition policies which resulted in a child being left unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: It was determined during the investigation that a child was put in a highchair after biting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were missing the following items:    The operational policies were missing:    - Procedures for Parental notifications  - Discipline and Guidance policies  - Suspension and Expulsion procedures  - Immunization requirements for children  - Hearing and Vision screening requirements  - Transportation policy  - Water activities policy  - Field trips policy  - Animals policy  - Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity  - Procedures for providing and applying insect repellant and sunscreen  - Information on vaccine preventable diseases for employees
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge: Staff were unaware of an official designation of someone being in charge during the director's absence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: 3 Caregivers did not have background check submissions and routinely work at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 1 Staff is missing the following requirements:    - Affidavit  - Orientation  - Employment Hire Date  - Education Qualification
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The operation used unlicensed , non-fenced space for outdoor activities for children under the age of 2 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The annual certification for the CPSC form was last updated in 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented annual training - Specific to water safety: Caregivers did not have water safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented annual training - Specific to water safety (26 TAC §746.1325(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: 2 Staff are missing annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: One caregiver is routinely at the operation with an ineligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The annual fire inspection had not been conducted since February of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 3 children did not have health statements on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director did not have records available showing her attendance at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not been conducing monthly fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: 3 Children's files did not have their date of admission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 3 Caregivers did not have the required annual trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's file did not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: 2 Children's files did not have physician or medical facility information under authorizied emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: Two employees who transport children did not have the required transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))
